blocks.text: Community platform with courses, memberships, and AI-powered engagement

Mighty Networks positions itself as a complete community business platform - not just a discussion forum, but an ecosystem for courses, events, memberships, and member connections. The platform is built around the idea that communities create more value when members connect with each other, not just with the creator.

The AI-powered member matching is a distinctive feature. Mighty Networks suggests connections between members based on shared interests, goals, and backgrounds. This proactive matching creates the serendipitous connections that make communities valuable beyond content alone.

For creators building community-based businesses, Mighty Networks handles the full stack: branded mobile apps, payment processing, member management, content delivery, and event hosting. One platform replaces what would otherwise require five or six separate tools.
Suggest connections between members based on shared attributes
Native iOS and Android apps under your brand
Sell and deliver courses within your community
Virtual and in-person events with registration and reminders
Free and paid membership tiers with content gating
Create focused spaces within your larger community

Mighty Networks' member matching and branded app features create communities that feel more valuable than typical forums or group chats. For creators where member-to-member connections drive value, it is the right choice.
